title: 27. 미안해 한마디, 마음이 말랑!
titleT: 27. One "Sorry," and Your Heart Turns Soft!

pages.ko: 우당탕! 호리가 방을 붕붕 뛰어다니다 그만, 토토가 쌓던 블록탑을 발로 툭! 와르르르— 알록달록 블록이 사방으로 굴러가요. "어… 어떡해." 호리는 그 자리에 딱 멈춰 섰어요.
pages.t: Crash bang! Hori was zooming around the room and accidentally kicked the block tower Toto had been building! Crash — the bright, colorful blocks scattered everywhere. "Uh oh... what do I do." Hori froze right there on the spot.

pages.ko: 토토가 울먹울먹, 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁. "내가 한참 쌓았는데…" 호리는 얼굴이 화끈화끈 달아올라요. '미안하다고 말해야 하는데…' 그런데 부끄러워서 입이 딱 붙어 버렸어요.
pages.t: Toto's eyes welled up with tears, about to cry. "I worked on that for so long..." Hori's face burned hot with embarrassment. 'I should say sorry...' But he felt so ashamed that his mouth wouldn't open.

pages.ko: 입을 꾹 다문 호리는 슬그머니 돌아서 버렸어요. 토토는 혼자 조용히 블록을 주워요. 톡, 톡, 톡… 둘 사이에 찬바람이 쌩— 방 안이 어쩐지 조용해졌어요.
pages.t: Keeping his mouth shut tight, Hori quietly turned away. Toto silently picked up the blocks alone. Tick, tick, tick... A cold, awkward feeling passed between them, and the room fell strangely quiet.

pages.ko: 방으로 온 엄마가 호리의 시무룩한 얼굴을 보았어요. "우리 호리, 마음이 무겁구나?" 엄마가 호리를 무릎에 앉히고 도닥도닥. "괜찮아. 마음이 무거울 땐, 어떻게 하면 좋을까?" 호리는 가만히 생각에 잠겼어요.
pages.t: Mom came into the room and saw Hori's gloomy face. "Our Hori's heart feels heavy, doesn't it?" Mom sat Hori on her lap and patted him gently. "It's okay. When your heart feels heavy, what should we do?" Hori sat quietly, thinking it over.

pages.ko: 호리는 가만히 생각했어요. 사과를 안 하니까 가슴 속에 커다란 돌멩이가 콩— 얹힌 것 같아요. 무겁고, 답답하고, 콕콕 찔러요. "이 돌멩이… 어떻게 치우지?"
pages.t: Hori thought quietly to himself. Because he hadn't apologized, it felt like a big heavy stone had settled in his chest, plunk. It was heavy, stuffy, and it kept poking at him. "This stone... how do I get rid of it?"

pages.ko: 그때 토토가 살며시 다가왔어요. "호리야… 나 사실 같이 놀고 싶어." 토토도 마음이 무거웠던 거예요. 호리 가슴이 쿵— 뛰었어요. 토토가 먼저 손을 내밀어 준 거예요.
pages.t: Just then, Toto quietly came closer. "Hori... I actually still want to play with you." Toto's heart had felt heavy too. Hori's heart went thump. Toto had reached out his hand first.

pages.ko: 호리는 꼭 쥔 두 주먹에 용기를 모았어요. 후우— 크게 숨을 쉬고, 토토를 똑바로 보며 말했어요. "토토야, 아까 탑 무너뜨려서… 미안해!" 미안해 한마디면, 마음이 폭신!
pages.t: Hori gathered up his courage in his two tightly clenched fists. He took a big breath, whoosh — and looked straight at Toto and said, "Toto, I knocked down your tower earlier... I'm sorry!" Just one "sorry," and your heart turns soft as a cloud!

pages.ko: 그 순간, 가슴을 누르던 돌멩이가 사르르— 폭신한 솜사탕으로 변했어요! 마음이 가볍고 폭신폭신. 토토도 방긋 웃으며 말해요. "괜찮아! 나도 같이 놀고 싶었어."
pages.t: In that moment, the stone pressing on his chest melted away — and turned into fluffy cotton candy! His heart felt light and soft as a cloud. Toto smiled brightly and said, "It's okay! I wanted to play together too."

pages.ko: 둘은 다시 사이좋게 블록을 쌓아요. 톡톡, 차곡차곡, 아까보다 훨씬 더 높이! "우와, 우리 성이 하늘까지 닿겠다!" 미안해 한마디면, 마음이 폭신!
pages.t: The two of them happily built blocks together again. Tap, tap, stacking them up, even higher than before! "Wow, our castle is going to reach the sky!" Just one "sorry," and your heart turns soft as a cloud!

pages.ko: 엄마가 두 친구를 꼬옥 폭— 안아 주었어요. "미안해라고 말할 줄 아는 우리 호리, 정말 멋져!" 이제 호리는 알아요. 잘못했을 땐 부끄러워도 미안해 한마디면, 마음이 폭신해진다는 걸! 미안해 한마디면, 마음이 폭신!
pages.t: Mom gave the two friends a big warm hug. "Our Hori knows how to say sorry — that's so wonderful!" Now Hori knows that even when it feels embarrassing to admit a mistake, just one "sorry" makes your heart turn soft as a cloud! Just one "sorry," and your heart turns soft as a cloud!

overview.ko: 친구의 모래성을 실수로 무너뜨린 호리가 부끄러움을 이겨내고 사과하여 더 깊이 친해지는 사회성 동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a social-skills story about Hori, who accidentally knocked down a friend's sandcastle, overcoming his embarrassment to apologize and growing even closer as friends.

lessons.t: Understand the warmth that comes from apologizing.

readingTips.ko: '미안해 한마디, 마음이 말랑' 후렴을 따뜻하게 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the "one sorry, and your heart turns soft" refrain in a warm voice.
Talk with your child about a time they apologized to someone.
